scope: Exact-build research design for authoritative effective asset binding before Drive NativeBegin; no implementation or product safety assertion.
remainingGap: OfflineManifestBinding attests a bounded read made by the host. It neither freezes current native provider registration/prepared state/Panacea metadata nor causes the later worker and remaster callbacks to consume those exact owned bytes.

establishedCallSequence.effect: NativeBegin already mutates requested form/source/party before target resource loading.
Separate OS worker owns normal load execution; priority400000 scheduler completion is3A0790.
Overlap retirement precedes file semaphore wait;106700(register=1) runs inside the acquired interval; current ResourceEntry is attached to BAR after release.
Registered primary bytes are read/decoded, metadata cache is updated or reused, file closes, then retail12F070 registers.
Name/length/payload dispatch creates ResourceEntry; mode3 consumes remaster count, allocated payloads, names and IDs.
Metadata is selected by current package cached name; replacement bytes are independently selected/reopened. Raw replacement mode/offsets come from the cached row while its seed is read anew.
Both worker and game thread parse before the later Drive preconstructor checkpoint.

properties: Target worker loader holds it during primary load and package-mode registration/remaster reads.
Calling3F9850 while already owning it would wait again.
It does not freeze external filesystem names/bytes, and the reviewed cleanup/teardown occurs outside its interval.
Native callers do not comprehensively handle wait/release failure.
Wake semaphore and waiter count are scheduling state, not a cache/resource generation.
Timing15EE10 can signal a waiting worker.
No safe loader-quiescence API or worker join is established by this research.

ownedHandoffDesign.requirement: Before NativeBegin, resolve the entire actual target dependency graph from bounded validated data, including base/target player, both eligible weapon hands, form/revert motion, recursive object resources and all remaster dependencies. Reject missing/corrupt/unsupported selected providers before any Drive side effect.
ownedHandoffDesign.state: Graph requirements and early parsers known; complete typed model/motion/remaster validators still unfinished.

ownedHandoffDesign.requirement: Create an immutable private ticket graph containing exact request spelling/prefix, provider ordinal and registration identity, selected HED row/PKG span or loose/raw provenance, logical primary bytes and digest, ordered remaster names/IDs/decoded bytes and digests. No pointer may borrow a mutable package/cache vector.
ownedHandoffDesign.state: Feasible data model; the shipped reader handles primary offline bytes only and remains unchanged.

ownedHandoffDesign.requirement: Bind the native snapshot/commit to a generated provider-registration/cache epoch and a generated request/resource identity. Capture under an actually proven safe scheduling/serialization point; check supported modules, hooks, package order, current prepared source and active roots. Never equate a pointer/name/hash of disk file with a live lease.
ownedHandoffDesign.state: No native generation exists in examined paths; observers/controlled publication and bootstrap rules need implementation proof.

ownedHandoffDesign.requirement: At the existing normal loader handoff before PanaceaFA50/retail12F070, select the ticket for the expected worker request. Supply validated primary bytes and expose a scoped immutable remaster count/name/ID/data service throughout ResourceEntry construction. Disk/Panacea cache lookups must not be repeated for ticket-owned dependencies.
ownedHandoffDesign.state: Concrete interception boundary identified. Safe hook installation, exact hook-chain composition, reentrancy and lifetime are not implemented.

ownedHandoffDesign.requirement: Perform native registration exactly once in its normal context. Remaster buffers transferred to ReplaceEntry must use the allocator compatible with retail _aligned_free, have exact lengths, and have a single owner. Track discarded-by-region, successfully transferred, failed/unconsumed and retired allocations separately.
ownedHandoffDesign.state: Constructor/destructor ownership is proven; all exceptional cleanup/OOM cases need a separate verified design.

ownedHandoffDesign.requirement: Bind published resource entries/registry records to the ticket identity and generated allocation lifetime. Track relocation and retirement; compare verified ingestion digests before native BAR header/fixup mutation, not arbitrary later mutated bytes.
ownedHandoffDesign.state: Registry and BAR mutation paths already documented; no new authoritative resource observer exists.

ownedHandoffDesign.requirement: Preflight and preallocate before NativeBegin so valid scoped requests cannot miss their ticket during the stateful transition. Keep module/ticket memory resident until all borrowers retire. Resolve every after-Begin failure with a separately proven continuation or rollback; do not return null/zero as a substitute.
ownedHandoffDesign.state: After-Begin cancellation/constructor-null path remains unsafe; implementation is not release-ready.

notSufficient: Hashing only the main raw/loose/PKG content.
Holding the CFileMan semaphore while taking a host filesystem snapshot.
Checking filename or map-node/vector pointer equality.
Calling lookup/read/register/destruct APIs as validation probes.
Validating only at40D119 or immediately before40D250.
Checking only a returned load length or primary ResourceEntry MD5.
Relying on native idle waiter count as a generation or quiescence token.

proposedEvidenceOnlyInterface.name: BoundResourceTicketGraph (future design, not a source API)
proposedEvidenceOnlyInterface.admission: All data and supported-state checks complete before NativeBegin; selected higher-priority invalid input rejects rather than retail fallback.
proposedEvidenceOnlyInterface.completion: Actual native publication and final pre-teardown identity checks must agree with the ticket; a host staging response alone never means RuntimeBound.
proposedEvidenceOnlyInterface.externalMutation: Owned bytes consumed from the ticket avoid later file reopening; any provider policy changes require a separate epoch/commit rule. A second filesystem check is only an offline consistency check.

regressionDesign: Same primary bytes but changed remaster list/count/name/ID.
Raw replaced between primary close and remaster reopen; offsets remain cached but header/content changes.
CacheEnabled hit after source changes; same node with vector reallocation or in-place row overwrite.
Raw cache overwrite despite an existing loose cache key.
Higher-priority raw or loose/remastered file appears after host snapshot.
Provider list/index/package pointer changes or is torn down while app pointer remains nonnull.
Invalid signed count/index, overflowing row spans, unterminated names, invalid region/name-table indices, decode-length mismatch.
Both hands, Revert0 and all target forms; graph miss found before Begin.
Nested/parallel load and timing wake during staging; no recursive semaphore acquisition.
Native registration called once; every remaster buffer freed/transferred once; region-discard path and destructor path.
Observer starts after resource already loaded; no fabricated generation or primary digest of mutated BAR.
Cancellation/host disconnect/fault after nativeBegin; no claimed rollback without complete state restoration.
Exception during hook-chain temporary unpatch/repatch; uncertain publication remains resident/faulted.
Native allocation failure remains a distinct unsupported failure unless redesigned.
